FN-DG4URTN-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 336
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Will Barfoot
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/10/2026
Senate Bill 336 as introduced could increase license fee receipts to the Department of Human
Resources (DHR) by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of child-care
facilities operating for-profit or engaged in 24-hour residential care that would now be required
to have a license to operate. This bill would also increase the administrative obligations of DHR
to adopt rules pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
Further, this bill could increase receipts to the State General Fund and municipal general funds
from fines; increase receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds, municipal general
funds, and other funds to which court costs are deposited; and could increase the obligations of
the State General Fund, district attorneys, and local jails by an undetermined amount dependent
upon the number of persons charged with and convicted of the offenses provided by this bill and
the penalties imposed.
